literal: Fault-indeed let one guard against as the main objective; fault-indeed is the ruin bringing enemy.
translation: Make guarding against faults your primary objective, for a fault is an enemy that brings about your ruin.
modern: குற்றம் ஏற்படாமல் காத்துக்கொள்வதையே ஒருவன் தன் முக்கிய நோக்கமாகக் கொள்ள வேண்டும்; ஏனெனில், குற்றமே ஒருவனுக்கு அழிவைத் தரும் பகையாகும்.
explanation: This couplet advises making the avoidance of faults one's primary goal in life. The word 'பொருளாக' (as the main objective or wealth) emphasizes that guarding against one's own flaws is as important as acquiring wealth. The repetition of 'குற்றமே' (fault itself) stresses that one's own mistakes are the real danger. Ultimately, a fault acts as an internal enemy that brings about one's downfall.
